suppressions.comment: Legal audits, ADR-011 (Clean-Room Compliance), the IP migration plan and the risk register must be able to name the franchise they are steering clear of; a compliance document forbidden from naming the risk cannot describe it. Scoped to NAMED FILES, not Docs/** -- a blanket glob silenced the rule everywhere including the scanner's own corpus test, which caught it. Anything new in Docs/ is guarded again, and the shipping Config/DefaultGame.ini description was rewritten rather than suppressed because it travels inside the packaged build.

This document quotes the copyright notice it is planning migration AWAY from. Quoting it is the point; the alternative is a migration plan that cannot say what it is migrating from.
The module header records that the SAGE XML ingestion path and EA's schemas were deleted on 2026-08-06. Naming what was removed is how the next reader learns not to re-add it.
Zero-byte directory placeholders. They carry no content to have provenance for; the directories they hold open are themselves recorded in the asset registry as pending third-party namespaces.
